look_here_first: Look at opposite leaves and rounded white flower heads on slender stalks; inspect bracts with a hand lens to distinguish from other Alternanthera.

morphology_keys.habit: Sprawling perennial, sometimes forming floating mats in wet habitats.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Simple opposite leaves at stem nodes.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: White papery flowers in rounded stalked heads.
morphology_keys.stem_nodes: Creeping stems can root at nodes.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Tiny fruit; close-up not yet documented.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Alligatorweed has stalked globose heads and often grows in wet sites; A. pungens has sharp prickly bracts; A. caracasana forms low mats with compact heads. Confirm bracts rather than habitat alone.

diagnostic_image_needs: Selected USDA-NRCS exact-species photo: stalked flower head and opposite leaves; install and verify.
Needs: whole floating mat, rooted stem nodes, bract macro, mature fruit macro, matched chaffweed comparison. Anatomy arrows pending verification.
